A hostile operator running 71 aliases hence needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 833 identities would post 4549 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
